facts.fact: The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism reports that Senegal adopted the access to information law and now has a specific legal framework for the right to information, with sanctions for non-compliance; the report gives no date for the law, so its publication date 2026-05-22 is used.

The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism reports that Senegal created the Commission nationale d'accès à l'information (CONAI) under the law; the report gives no date for its creation, so its publication date 2026-05-22 is used.
